messages:
Nina: Heads up — Aperture Systems just put the pilot on hold. They want an executive bridge before resuming. Main blockers: custom SSO metadata + allowlist, pilot commercial terms (discount cap), and a request for SOC2 artifacts + KMS options. Can we assemble a rapid response?
Omar: Tech POV: they need SAML 2.0 metadata + our websocket egress IPs. Their infra team also asked about TLS termination and whether we support mTLS. We don't for Hosted API.
Sanjay: Security: they asked if we can support BYO-KMS for pilot. Short answer: BYO-KMS only on Private. For Hosted we can offer CMEK on certain clouds but keys are managed. Will write a short note.
Tess: Commercial: they want 45% off pilot and 120k non-binding ARR credit if it converts. That's above our standard pilot bands. Need CRO signoff for anything >30%. Also ask: do we require a minimum committed ARR on conversion?
Nina: @Tess please capture options. I'll try to get CRO into the bridge.
LegalBot: Reminder: SOC2 + pen test reports are controlled docs. We require an NDA + DPA before sharing redacted artifacts. Templates available in /legal/templates.
Sanjay: Also need to confirm scope of SOC2 artifacts they want. A typical share includes: SOC2 summary, coverage period, and redacted controls matrix. We should avoid full pen-test reports without a signed NDA.
Omar: IP ranges we can give them (prelim): 3.121.0.0/16, 18.198.0.0/15. Will confirm with infra. If they use private peering we'll provide different ranges.
Nina: Action list draft: 1) Nina -> schedule exec bridge (ETA 30m). 2) Tess -> pricing fallback (30% cap + credits) + conversion terms (ETA 2h). 3) Omar -> finalize IP ranges + mTLS note (ETA 1h). 4) Sanjay -> SOC2 share checklist + BYO-KMS one-pager (ETA EOD). 5) Legal -> send NDA + DPA template and requested signatures (ETA 3h).
Tess: Proposed fallback: 30% pilot discount, $20k in usage credits, 90-day trial. Conversion: 12-month commitment at $300k ARR to unlock additional enterprise discount. If CRO declines, propose approval workflow.
infra-bot: New calendar event created: "Aperture Systems exec bridge" — tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Attendees: Nina, Tess, Omar, Sanjay.
Sanjay: I'll prepare a 1-page security brief and an excerpt of the SOC2 summary we can share post-NDA. Also drafting BYO-KMS bullet points.
Nina: If we can get the DPA and IP CIDRs before the bridge we can answer most infra/security asks live. I'll ping CRO and GC.
Tess: I'll assemble a slide with the commercial fallback and notes on escalation path for CRO approval.
Nina: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits a blocker, post updates here — will DM CRO now. :+1:
